description: Implementation of FAT filesystem interface for Zephyr OS, including file operations, directory management, mounting, unmounting, and error translation.

methods.name: translate_error
methods.description: Converts FATFS error codes to POSIX error codes.

methods.name: translate_path
methods.description: Converts Zephyr path to FATFS-compatible path by stripping leading slash.

methods.name: translate_flags
methods.description: Translates Zephyr fs_mode_t flags to FATFS mode flags.

methods.name: fatfs_open
methods.description: Opens a file with specified mode.

methods.name: fatfs_close
methods.description: Closes an open file.

methods.name: fatfs_unlink
methods.description: Deletes a file at given path.

methods.name: fatfs_rename
methods.description: Renames or moves a file.

methods.name: fatfs_read
methods.description: Reads data from an open file.

methods.name: fatfs_write
methods.description: Writes data to an open file.

methods.name: fatfs_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in a file.

methods.name: fatfs_tell
methods.description: Returns current position in a file.

methods.name: fatfs_truncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to specified length.

methods.name: fatfs_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes file data to storage.

methods.name: fatfs_mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory.

methods.name: fatfs_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory for reading.

methods.name: fatfs_readdir
methods.description: Reads next directory entry.

methods.name: fatfs_closedir
methods.description: Closes an open directory.

methods.name: fatfs_stat
methods.description: Gets information about a file or directory.

methods.name: fatfs_statvfs
methods.description: Gets filesystem statistics.

methods.name: fatfs_mount
methods.description: Mounts the FAT filesystem.

methods.name: fatfs_unmount
methods.description: Unmounts the FAT filesystem.

methods.name: fatfs_mkfs
methods.description: Creates a new FAT filesystem (if enabled).

methods.name: fatfs_init
methods.description: Registers the FAT filesystem with Zephyr.
